posts.title: Responsibility Is Taken Before It Is Given
posts.description: To get promoted as a software engineer in Big Tech, you generally need to show “ownership” of a product or area. This means being responsible for it and deciding what should happen over time. I often hear more junior engineers ask: “How can I demonstrate ownership when my manager hasn’t given me anything to own?” This way of thinking is a trap: an easy one to fall into, but a trap nonetheless.
